protocol.independence: Strict historical direct-target and assessment prohibition, including unrelated models; unknown roles stay restricted. Complete generated ancestry from occupied 12, roots and legal root children historical/mutually disjoint. No post-outcome replacement or clean-subset rescue. Audit every played path before aggregate scores; any prohibited/unresolved encounter blocks the whole confirmation.
protocol.statistics: Mean of 256 complete color-swapped family points; require both Hoeffding and approximate one-sided Student 95% lower bounds > .5; 10,000 whole-family resamples within 16 strata as sensitivity. No interim tests, extension or pooling.
protocol.warmup: Separate persistent B/P processes, restarted before each game; same first 16 disclosed native-engineering roots D3 for both models, execution order alternates by game. Warmup excluded from move clocks but included in full runtime.
protocol.authorization: Reversi Phase A — Execute the Independent P-versus-B Tournament on the M4
protocol.checkpoint: Immutable per-game receipts and atomic complete-pair receipts; every move prefix durable. Resume skips verified complete pairs only. An interrupted partial pair is retained and stops confirmation; no replay/replacement to recover a favorable outcome.
protocol.student: one-sided alpha .05; critical t(.95,255); also descriptive two-sided 95% interval. Zero observed variance does not establish a constant population.
protocol.bootstrap: 10,000 draws; ascending cell then ascending family; 16 sampled with replacement in each of 16 cells; seededRandom(2026103192); whole families, score and margin jointly; two-sided 95% percentile sensitivity.

retentionLimits: Two pure backend timing pilots retain no played paths. Exact source prefixes, roots and alternatives recovered. Collector establishes engineering-only purpose; they are not invented fitting targets or missing P/L assessment panels. This limits universal historical-observation completeness, not the verified known-target/assessment coverage.
